== Closing Blessing ==
We are very imperfect beings in a very imperfect universe.  We strive toward ideals, but recognize that these are only simplistic fantasies, and what we ultimately achieve will be imperfect.  Yet our minds need a simple story, so may we strive to balance our acceptance of our own and the world’s messy nature with an excited, passionate drive to realize as much of our utopian story as possible.  -- Blessed Be
